case_studies_published_image_check.name: case_studies_published_image_check
case_studies_published_image_check.value: "cms"."case_studies"."status" <> 'published' or ("cms"."case_studies"."image_key" is not null and "cms"."case_studies"."image_alt" is not null and "cms"."case_studies"."image_width" is not null and "cms"."case_studies"."image_height" is not null)

testimonials_logo_check.name: testimonials_logo_check
testimonials_logo_check.value: ("cms"."testimonials"."logo_key" is null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_width" is null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_height" is null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_size" is null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_type" is null) or ("cms"."testimonials"."logo_key" is not null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_width" is not null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_height" is not null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_size" is not null and "cms"."testimonials"."logo_type" is not null)

jobs_salary_range_check.name: jobs_salary_range_check
jobs_salary_range_check.value: "recruitment"."jobs"."salary_max" is null or ("recruitment"."jobs"."salary_min" is not null and "recruitment"."jobs"."salary_max" >= "recruitment"."jobs"."salary_min")
